title: Dustwallow Marsh
body: Dustwallow Marsh is a fog-bound swamp on the eastern coast of Kalimdor, and for ages it belonged to its beasts and the Stonemaul ogres. After the Third War Jaina Proudmoore brought the survivors of her expedition here and raised the island city of Theramore. The peace has never been easy: her father fell at Theramore when his fleet came against the Horde, the Stonemaul, burned out of their southern home by black dragonkin, now hold Brackenwall for the Horde, and in the Wyrmbog Onyxia, daughter of Deathwing, broods in her lair.

parts.body: The marsh has grown busier: Grimtotem tauren have raised war camps in the north, and goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel have founded Mudsprocket in the south, open to Theramore and the Horde alike.

title: Theramore Isle
body: Theramore stands on a rocky isle off the coast, a walled city of stone founded by the humans, dwarves and high elves who followed Jaina Proudmoore to Kalimdor after Mount Hyjal. Her tower rises at its heart, and Captain Garran Vimes runs the city guard from Foothold Citadel. Not all who crossed the sea accept her peace with the Horde: marines still loyal to her dead father have deserted, and some hold the abandoned watchtower of Lost Point.

parts.body: SI:7 has broken the deserters' hold inside the walls, and their leader, Gavis Greyshield, surrendered asking only that his men be spared; with care, Jaina may yet bring them back to the fold.

title: Brackenwall Village
body: Brackenwall Village is the Horde's stronghold in the marsh, a rough camp where the Stonemaul ogres took refuge after black dragonkin burned them out of their southern village. Overlord Mok'Morokk was raised to rule them by Rexxar himself, but once his patron left, power went to his head: he ordered his people to run rather than fight, and pines for the grog and strongbox he abandoned. Many of his ogres want revenge and their old home.

parts.body: The learned ogre Draz'Zilb's spells name the dragons: the brood of Onyxia, who did not come to the marsh merely to besiege a band of ogres.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Dustwallow_Marsh (Brackenwall founded by Stonemaul, the Horde's foothold)

parts.body: Challenged before his people, Mok'Morokk was beaten and fled like a frightened child, leaving the clan free to choose a leader who will take them home.

title: Shady Rest Inn
body: Only a blackened chimney and rubble remain of the Shady Rest Inn, on the road where Dustwallow meets the Barrens. James Hyal, who crossed the sea with Jaina, built it. When Theramore lost the marsh roads he was too stubborn to retreat behind its walls, and the inn was burned, his wife and son killed. James never recovered: in Theramore's inn he sings the same few lines over and over, and the guards call him Smiling Jim.

parts.body: A blackened iron shield fixed to the chimney is the work of Mosarn, a smith of Thunder Bluff, and its burned strap was made for someone large, likely a tauren.
sources: quest 1282 reward text (opened an inn at the edge of the Barrens; lost control of the roads; too stubborn)

parts.body: The burners were Grimtotem, a band camped at Direhorn Post beside Tabetha's farm, part of the clan's war on everyone who has settled the marsh.

title: Tabetha's Farm
body: In the heart of the Quagmire stands the small farm of Tabetha, a hermit mage and scryer far older than she looks, who has trained generations of apprentices here, Horde mages among them. Both Theramore and Brackenwall trust her, and she has done more than most to keep the peace between them; young mages of both sides make the long trip into the swamp to earn their wands from her.

parts.body: She has new neighbors: the Grimtotem of Direhorn Post just to the north raid her farm by day, determined to drive her and her students out.

title: Alcaz Island
body: Alcaz Island lies off the northeastern coast, a lush tropical isle ruled by the Strashaz naga, whose Tidelord commands from behind barred gates. On the shore near Theramore, Mirefin murlocs crowd the beaches of the Dreadmurk Shore, and the criminal mastermind Doctor Weavil has landed his flying machine on the island with a band of minions.

parts.body: Survivors of a wrecked ship, wearing Defias red, now camp on the Dreadmurk islets: the Defias, never sailors, have come to Kalimdor to recover some precious cargo.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Alcaz_Island (naga, Weavil and his flying machine, Rrurgaz)

parts.body: The cargo was a captive in enchanted manacles, and above Alcaz black dragonkin work a rune circle. The Defias, Jaina says, serve a far greater power than any grudge of their own.

title: Wyrmbog
body: The Wyrmbog is the deepest corner of the south, a reeking marsh where the black dragonflight is strongest. Behind a cave mouth shaped like a dragon's jaws lies the lair of Onyxia, daughter of Deathwing, her eggs hidden all around it, and her brood has spread across the steaming fens of the Dragonmurk to the north. In a den of his own dwells the old drake Emberstrife, a gatekeeper who tests the dragonspawn that would guard the brood mother.
